description: End-to-end and measurement tooling: the new test/e2e/site.mjs (14 phone, tablet and desktop sizes, motion on and off, no-JS, privacy, routes, keyboard, OFFLINE=1 production runs) with R2, R3 and R7 included, the CI 'Landing page' step, the final axe targets, lighthouse 13.6.0 as a root dev dependency with scripts/lighthouse.mjs and lighthouse-lib.mjs plus unit tests, and the test docs. Depends on FEAT-001 to FEAT-003 (it checks the finished page).

findings: Verification (this checkout, dev server on :3000, nothing committed), all after the last code change: pnpm -r typecheck pass; pnpm -F @ninth/web test --run pass (30 files, 334 tests; new lighthouse-lib.test.ts 10, keypad-demo.test.tsx now 19); BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000 node test/e2e/site.mjs 'all checks passed' (Chromium); ENGINE=webkit same, 'all checks passed'; BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000 node test/e2e/axe.mjs 'all checks passed' (landing / and landing / (motion) 0 violations, 29 rules, Night+Day, 1280+390); node scripts/lighthouse.mjs --url http://localhost:3000/ printed 'This is a development server; Lighthouse needs `next start`.' and exited 2; tm-lint clean (23 files); validate-kiro-config ok (10 hooks); check-kiro-not-ignored ok (4 untracked files under .kiro/). Measured on the dev server (Chromium): bar 80px at 360x668 and 144px at 320x568 (two rows; MS-10.7 asserts 80px only at 360x668); h1 bottom 232 / hero CTA bottom 600 at 360x668, h1 210 / CTA 458 at 874x330; drawn keys 64-84px at every size and with XL keys; 28 targets on phones, 33 on tablet/desktop, all >= 56px with >= 8px in-group gaps; at most 1 ember fill on screen (2 on the page); autoplay read Stop 1.2-1.25 s after the demo was in view; layout shift with motion on 0.0008 (1280x900) and 0.0041 (390x844), motion off 0; LCP element P; 35 keyboard focus stops at 1280x900, each with a 4px outline, none covered; 11 requests in each privacy run, all same-origin, no cookies, no storage writes, no IndexedDB, no dialog. Deviations and notes for FEAT-005: (1) PAGE FIX, decided by the agent on the person's word ('you decide'): site.mjs first measured a layout shift of 0.036 at 390x844 with motion on (limit 0.02), because the centred demo chips grew during the play and pushed each other sideways (and 'water' wrapped to a second row). KeypadDemo now renders one fixed slot per finished word (li.site-demo__slot = .site-sizer grid holding a hidden finished chip in span.site-demo__chip-ghost plus the live ProofChip, justify-self start); untyped slots have no live chip and are aria-hidden; the separate ul.site-demo__chips-ghost and .site-demo__chipbox are gone. The finished frame looks as before (centred, same wrap). design.md 'No layout shift' bullet updated; selectors in site.test.tsx MS-6.2 and keypad-demo.test.tsx now use '.site-demo__slot > [data-state="match"]' (live chips) and '.site-demo__chip-ghost' (copies); new keypad-demo case 'MS-6.10 every chip keeps a fixed slot'. (2) MS-8.9 check waits 200 ms after the play ends: the last pressed key's ring fades out over motion-jump (A3, 120 ms) and was still running at the instant the label changed. (3) WebKit, like Safari, skips links on Tab: site.mjs presses Alt+Tab (Option+Tab) under ENGINE=webkit and has its own tabTo; lib.mjs is unchanged. (4) WebKit skips the scroll-linked frame check, LCP and layout shift with a printed note; the autoplay-skip rule (demo taller than viewport/0.6) never triggered at 1280x900 or 390x844. (5) OFFLINE=1 runs were not executed (dev server); they wait in the cache for a pathname '/app' entry (60 s timeout), then go offline, openApp(page) and reload '/'. First real run is FEAT-005 step 30 against next start. (6) pnpm install for lighthouse 13.6.0 also changed the lockfile's next resolution to include the optional peer @opentelemetry/api 1.10.0 (brought in by lighthouse); the dev server went down at about that time and the orchestrator restarted it. pnpm-lock.yaml must be committed with package.json (CI uses --frozen-lockfile). (7) lighthouse.mjs: imports lighthouse and lighthouse/core/config/desktop-config.js dynamically after the dev-server check; Chromium via loadPlaywright() with channel 'chromium' and --remote-debugging-port on a free port; reports to packages/web/test-results/lighthouse/<preset>-<run>.json; median-Performance run supplies metrics, LCP element (tag from the largest-contentful-paint-element audit's node snippet) and network-requests; mobile misses include CLS > 0.02, an img LCP, any type over budget and any other origin. lighthouse-lib.mjs also exports lcpElementTag and writeBlock (adds '## Landing page (Lighthouse)' with markers when missing; performance.md already has the section and empty markers). Never run against a production build yet. (8) dev.html fixture holds the five real script tags saved from the dev server (webpack.js?v=..., main-app.js?v=...). (9) CI: step 'Landing page (sizes, motion, privacy, keyboard, offline)' after 'Phones and tablets', `OFFLINE=1 node packages/web/test/e2e/site.mjs`, if !cancelled(); job name lists phones and tablets and landing page. (10) Docs: tech.md (stack line, E2E row with site, Lighthouse Commands row), accessibility.md 'How to check' site.mjs line, docs/testing/README.md Landing page and Lighthouse rows plus the run line, performance.md Lighthouse section with how to run and empty markers, README License line. Ticked tasks 17, 18, 19, 20, 20.1, 22, 24, 25 in tasks.md. KIRO_LOG row added (2026-11-10, 'Kiro (marketing-landing workflow, FEAT-004)'). (11) Shell: run commands via nohup with logs in /tmp; site.mjs takes about 90 s in Chromium and 110 s in WebKit on the dev server.
